subject: Mathematics

show.line: This is a triangle. Three sides and three corners. Look, our house roof is a triangle!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Triangle!
Touch each corner. How many corners does a triangle have?
Papa cut the sandwiches. Which one is a triangle?
Put the triangles in one group. Put the others in the other group.

hints: A triangle has three pointy corners.
Look at the roof of a house. That is a triangle.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the corners of the roof.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A triangle has only three corners.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count them together. One, two, three corners!

parent_line: Can recognise a triangle and count its three corners.
